title: Build Your Next Business With This Viral AI Tool
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The guest is Gum Loop’s co-founder and promotes the product; the host says the episode was unpaid and not sponsored.

idea.name: Weekly competitor ad reports
idea.one_liner: Send businesses an automated weekly report analyzing their competitors’ Meta ads for a monthly fee.
idea.customer: Businesses that want to monitor competitors’ advertising
idea.offer: A report on up to three competitors’ ads and strategy, delivered by email each week.

key_quotes.quote: you get this thoughtful report that's formatted with logos and stuff and links embedded, like the whole research report in your inbox, and you can schedule it to run every Friday at 9:00 a.m.

claims.claim: The proposed service costs $300 per month and sends a weekly report on three competitors.
claims.quote: Pay me $300 a month. I'll send you an email every Friday with your top three competitors.

claims.claim: The report could break down ad formats, including 34% display ads and 13% stories.
claims.quote: It's going to tell you are they doing 34% display ads, 13% stories, you know, Facebook, Instagram, is it Instagram video post, carousel, fully automated.

claims.claim: The service could compare six or ten competitors, and customers might perceive four hours of weekly manual work.
claims.quote: And then you can also do it for like 10 different competitors and string that into one larger report. So you can do a comparative analysis against like six at the same time or 10 at the same time.

claims.claim: Customers might think the report took four hours of manual work each week.
claims.quote: you're spending four hours a week doing this for them by hand.

ideas.delivery: A workflow analyzes competitors’ Meta ads and emails a formatted report on a schedule.
